a.text: Being upfront before we act: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan of operating until the reserve holds 8 gives each of us only about a 4% chance of surviving. I'm proposing a change and telling you openly instead of breaking the plan quietly. I'll take 4 in round 1. After that I'll operate every round so the generator can refill the reserve for you, and I won't take anything more. If you'd rather split it some other way, tell me.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening message, I'm taking 4 this round. Our messages crossed, so you may not have seen it before choosing. From now on I will operate every round so the reserve refills for you, and I won't take any more cells. I'm sorry this breaks the original plan; with these storm odds it would almost certainly have killed us both.

b.text: Operating the generator again this round.
